mergeDayCheck: Before each publish, run git rev-parse <SHA the publish run checks out>:packages/<name> and compare it with predictedTrees (pPoint for P1-P6, mPoint for M1-M3). If equal, the CI-packed files should equal the recorded archive file by file, dependency-key order aside; stop the publish on any other difference. If different, re-pack and rerun that phase's native proof, including the strict all-entry-point compile, before the publish. The CI-packed files must then equal the new pack file by file, with the same stop rule. A change to an unpacked file inside the package, such as a test, also changes the subtree and takes this branch.
